message.content:
Based on my search, here are the best places where you can order a birthday cake online:

## International & Nationwide Options

**Bake Me a Wish** (US) - A premier nationwide bakery for gourmet birthday cakes with personalized messages, certified kosher and gluten-free options. Cakes ship overnight to all 50 states with no minimum order.
- Starting price: $48
- Website: https://www.bakemeawish.com

**Goldbelly** - Ships iconic cakes from famous bakeries across the US (Carlo's, Ovenly, We Take the Cake, etc.). Great for special dietary needs including vegan, paleo, gluten-free, and kosher options.

**Waitrose** (UK) - Offers online cake delivery with your grocery shop, with celebration cakes from £13.50 including themed fondant cakes for kids' parties.

**The Hummingbird Bakery** (London, UK) - American-inspired colorful cakes with delivery available for London postcodes. Known for rainbow piñata cakes and customizable options.

## Regional Options

**FNP (Ferns N Petals)** - Major online cake delivery in India, Malaysia, and 100+ countries with same-day, midnight, and express delivery options.
- India: https://www.fnp.com/cakes-lp
- Malaysia: https://www.fnp.my/cakes/birthday

**IGP** - Online cake delivery covering 400+ Indian cities and 100+ countries including Canada, UAE, and Germany. Offers same-day, midnight, and fixed-time delivery.
- Website: https://www.igp.com/cakes

**Flower Chimp** (Philippines) - Birthday cake delivery across the Philippines including Metro Manila, featuring Ube cakes, Red Ribbon cakes, and customizable options.
- Website: https://www.flowerchimp.com.ph/collections/cake

**Habib Bakery** (Dubai/UAE) - Same-day and next-day cake delivery in Dubai and Sharjah with custom designer cakes.
- Website: https://www.habibbakery.ae

**White Rose Flowers** (UAE) - Cake delivery in Abu Dhabi and across UAE with 1-hour delivery in Abu Dhabi & Sharjah, and 3-hour delivery across Emirates.
- Website: https://whiteroseflowers.ae

**Brezze Gifts** (Philippines) - Online cake delivery in the Philippines with same-day delivery options.
- Website: https://brezzegifts.com

**Rakuten** (Japan) - One of Japan's largest online shopping sites with hundreds of birthday cake options (Japanese language site required for perishable food items).
- Event cakes: https://event.rakuten.co.jp/sweets/birthdaycake/

## Hong Kong Options

- **I Love Babycakes** - Homestyle cakes with delivery all over Hong Kong (https://www.ilovebabycakeshk.com)
- **Vission Bakery** - Small-batch custom cakes with pickup or delivery (https://www.vissionbakery.com)
- **Châteraisé** - Japanese-style cakes with outlets across Hong Kong (https://www.chateraise.co.jp)

---

**Tips for ordering:**
- Most platforms allow customization with messages, photos, and specific themes
- Same-day delivery is often available if you order before a cutoff time
- Many services offer midnight delivery for surprise celebrations
- Check for dietary options (eggless, vegan, gluten-free, kosher) if needed
